text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Friday it cut its recommendation on Scientific Games Holdings Corp to hold from buy and trimmed earnings estimates based on, among other factors, lower pricing of some state lottery contracts.
Late yesterday, Scientific Games said it had negotiated an extension of its contract for the Georgia lottery, at a lower rate of return to the company.
Based on this, ABN AMRO Chicago said it was taking a more conservative view toward pricing in other contracts, including those with Indiana, Kentucky and Massachusetts.
Based on this, ABN AMRO Chicago said its earnings estimate for 1997 was lowered to $1.70 a share from $1.85, and 1998 was cut to $1.80 from $2.15.
It said it does not expect positive earnings comparisons to begin until the third quarter of 1998.
Shares of Scientific Games were off 7/8 to 19-1/2.
